mentions.h: LONDON VIDARIANS 4 MILES OPEN YOUTH & JUNIOR RACE: MITCHAM-7TH MAY
BELS. WIN HIGHGATE OPEN '7': Middleton in form:

photos.c: TOP LEFT: Don Bartliff (2) and his rivals are the only ones who can say what the female bystander's comments were! TOP RIGHT:Ken Bailey in the lead at 17 miles. BOTTOM LEFT:Ray Hall leads Dennis Read (the eventual winner) and D. Vale (S.W.C.) in the chase after Bailey. BOTTOM RIGHT:John Morris receives refreshment from Fred Denny, with John Keown alongside. Gerry Cameron follows by bicyle.
